'''Tasiele Shan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] descendant of the legendary [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Bastila Shan]]. She served as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in the [[Time/Legends|century]] before the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], and bore a daughter that she named [[Satele Shan|Satele]] in [[3699 BBY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. However, when she began to challenge the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] views on attachment and [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] like her [[Shan family|ancestors]] before her, the Republic pressured the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] into [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiling]] her to a [[Unidentified Outer Rim planet (Tasiele Shan)|unnamed]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] so that she could [[Meditation/Legends|meditate]] on her ideas. When the Council decided to retrieve Shan from her exile many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, they found only her cliffside dwelling and a set of journals dedicated to her daughter, which they passed on to the young Shan.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Shan brought one such work, entitled ''[[Aspects of the Force, The Light and the Dark]]'', with her on her self-imposed exile to the planet [[Odessen]] [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] later.<ref name="KOTFE">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=12}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tasiele Shan was first mentioned in Satele Shan's entry in the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] on the official site for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in an [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] phrase that read "Jedi exiled her mother". The entry went online on [[March 26]], [[2010]],<ref name="Holonet">{{HolonetOld|biographies|jedi-grand-master-satele-shan|Grand Master Satele Shan}}</ref> but it was not until the release of the game's reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' in [[2012]] that her name and backstory were given.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> A book written by Tasiele later appeared in Chapter 12 of [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], a Digital Expansion for ''The Old Republic''.<ref name="KOTFE" />
